one_liner: AI-powered web scraping and data extraction platform with a REST API and MCP server.
auth_notes: API tokens are managed from the dashboard and passed in the x-api-token header, or as a Bearer token for marketplace endpoints.
access_notes: Sign up for the free plan providing 1,000 tokens per month with no credit card required.
api_notes: REST API covering scrapers, unblocker, analytics, and platform management under api.app.mrscraper.com/api/v1.
blocker_notes: Fully available with self-serve free tier and documented public API.
